question: Who among the following is one of the co-authors of the book, ‘Cracking The Code:My Journey in Bollywood’?
solution:
The correct answer is **Ayushmann Khurrana**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ayushmann Khurrana** co-authored the book **'Cracking The Code: My Journey in Bollywood'** with his wife, Tahira Kashyap.
 
• The book is a personal account of Ayushmann's journey in the Indian film industry.
 
• It offers insights into the struggles and triumphs he faced while establishing himself as an actor.
 
• It serves as an inspiration to aspiring actors, providing them with tips and strategies to navigate Bollywood.
 
• The book was well-received for its honesty and the unique perspective it offers on the film industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ayushmann Khurrana** is a versatile actor known for his choice of unconventional roles and films that address social issues.
 
• He made his film debut in 2012 with **'Vicky Donor'**, which was critically acclaimed and commercially successful.
 
• Ayushmann is also a talented singer, having sung several popular songs for his movies.
 
• He has received numerous awards, including the **National Film Award** for Best Actor for his performance in 'Andhadhun'.
 
• His contribution to cinema goes beyond entertainment, as he often chooses projects that spark conversations on relevant social topics.
